description: This file contains helper methods related to rendering back-ends in the ANGLE graphics library, including functions for copying and manipulating pixel data, managing incomplete textures, and handling matrix uniforms and sample positions.

classes.name: IncompleteTextureSet
classes.description: Manages incomplete textures used as placeholders in the rendering context.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixGLSL
classes.description: Template struct for setting GLSL uniform matrices with various dimensions.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixHLSL
classes.description: Template struct for setting HLSL uniform matrices with various dimensions.

methods.name: CopyColor
methods.description: No-op function for copying color data.

methods.name: PremultiplyAlpha
methods.description: Premultiplies the RGB channels of a color by its alpha.

methods.name: UnmultiplyAlpha
methods.description: Unpremultiplies the RGB channels of a color by its alpha.

methods.name: ClipChannelsR
methods.description: Clips color channels to only red, sets green and blue to zero, alpha to 1.

methods.name: ClipChannelsRG
methods.description: Clips color channels to red and green, blue to zero, alpha to 1.

methods.name: ClipChannelsRGB
methods.description: Clips color channels to red, green, blue, alpha to 1.

methods.name: ClipChannelsLuminance
methods.description: Sets alpha to 1, clips other channels accordingly.

methods.name: ClipChannelsAlpha
methods.description: Sets red, green, blue to zero, alpha to 1.

methods.name: WriteUintColor
methods.description: Writes color data as unsigned int RGBA to pixel data.

methods.name: WriteFloatColor
methods.description: Writes color data as float RGBA to pixel data.

methods.name: GetFormatFromFormatType
methods.description: Returns the internal format for given GLenum format and type.

methods.name: ComputeStartVertex
methods.description: Calculates the starting vertex index for drawing, considering base vertex and index range.

methods.name: GetVertexRangeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the vertex range and start vertex for draw calls, handling index and base vertex.

methods.name: ClipRectToScissor
methods.description: Clips a rectangle to the current scissor rectangle if enabled.

methods.name: OverrideFeaturesWithDisplayState
methods.description: Overrides feature set based on display state.

methods.name: GetSamplePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the sample position for a given sample index, supporting standard sample sets.
